name: Kusakabe Kirari
source: A first-year student who is treated like a mascot because of her young and cute appearance. Because she has lived a spoiled life, she has a childish personality, and is both confident and vain. Her grades are low because she has no interest in studying, but she is quick-witted.
translation: A first-year student who is treated like a mascot because of her young and cute appearance. Because she has lived a spoiled life, she has a childish personality, and is both confident and vain. Her grades are low because she has no interest in studying, but she is quick-witted.
